title: Archytan Lite decision receipt, version 2
description: One signed decision, as minted by Archytan Lite 2.4 and later. Besides what was decided about which action, resource and actor, a v2 receipt records what the decision was made under: the SHA-256 of the policy and callers files in force, the credential that asked, the resource's tenant, the gate's mode and whether observe mode turned a refusal into an ALLOW, and the caller's W3C trace id. Every field is covered by the Ed25519 signature (under the ARCHYTAN_LITE_RECEIPT_V2: tag) except seq and chain_hash, which the hash chain protects. The request's idempotency key is signed too but never serialized, so a client verifies with the key it sent. An ALLOW receipt is returned in the /v1/authorize response under "receipt"; a BLOCK receipt is recorded and exported but never returned, the caller receiving only {"decision", "trace_id"}. Verify a receipt as received, never re-serialized. Schema validation checks shape only; integrity comes from the signature and the chain. See internal/receipt/v2.go.

receipt_version.description: The receipt format. A version 1 receipt has no such field (see receipt.v1.json).

receipt_id.description: "rcpt_" followed by 16 random bytes in hex.

operator_urn.description: The gate instance that made the decision (ARCHYTAN_LITE_INSTANCE_URN).

trace_id.description: The gate's per-request trace id, the same value a refused caller receives.

created_at.description: When the decision was made: RFC 3339 in UTC with nanoseconds, exactly as signed and as stored. Verify against this text as received.

action.description: The action requested, as named in policy.json.

resource_type.description: The type of the resource the action targets.

resource_id.description: The resource the action targets. Signed, so it can't be redacted without breaking verification.

resource_tenant_id.description: The tenant the request named on the resource, empty when it named none.

actor_uid.description: The actor identifier the caller supplied.

actor_role.description: The role the decision was made against: the credential's role in bound mode, the request's in shared-secret mode.

caller_id.description: The authenticated credential: its caller_id from the callers file in bound mode, "shared-secret-caller" in shared-secret mode.

mode.description: The gate's mode when it decided.

observe_override.description: True only when observe mode turned what would have been a BLOCK into this ALLOW.

policy_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the policy file bytes the decision was made against: the same hash Archytan Strategos records for an applied change.

callers_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the callers file in bound mode, empty in shared-secret mode.

otel_trace_id.description: The caller's W3C trace id from its traceparent header, empty when it sent none or an invalid one.

intent_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the signed fields.

signature.description: Hex Ed25519 signature by the gate's key over intent_hash, under the ARCHYTAN_LITE_RECEIPT_V2: tag.

seq.description: Position in the gate's chain, starting at 1.

chain_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 link to the receipt before it.
